name: Edvard Munch
findings: Within his own canvases, carolina blue turns up as a small accent in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 3.0x the archive's rate (from 2454 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, mustard turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 1.6x the archive's rate (from 2454 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, bordeaux turns up as the shadow in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.0x the archive's rate (from 2454 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2454 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2454 paintings here).
Pairs blackish grey with dim grey more than chance would predict (3 of 2454 paintings here).
Pairs brussels brown with dresden brown more than chance would predict (3 of 2454 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (oatmeal, smoky black, dark jungle green) covers 59% of his paintings here.
